Oh, absolutely. I use a standard, FDA-approved toothbrush, though I suppose in this brave new world of "effortless fitness," I should probably just shake it vigorously for ten minutes to achieve a sparkling, cavity-free smile.

It’s the ultimate hack, really. Why bother with the tedious, manual labor of actually brushing? That’s so last century. Instead, I simply hold my toothbrush like a tiny, bristly dumbbell and give it a few enthusiastic flicks. The physics are undeniable: if shaking a plastic weight can carve out a six-pack, surely shaking a piece of plastic with bristles can scrub away plaque. It’s the same principle, just applied to oral hygiene.

Why spend five minutes actually cleaning your teeth when you can spend ten minutes pretending to work out? It’s the epitome of efficiency. You get the aesthetic of a healthy smile without the inconvenience of actually touching your teeth. It’s not just dental care; it’s a lifestyle choice. And if your teeth still look yellow? Well, clearly, you didn’t shake them hard enough. Or perhaps you’re just not committed to the bit.
